Hi everyone. I am Mark Ellison, and I have just joined the Latin America team as director of client solutions. A little about me. I started my career in a small bank in Ohio, and I worked there for six years. Then I moved to Atlanta and joined a credit company. I have worked in credit risk for about fifteen years now. I have managed teams in three countries, but I have never worked with a team in Brazil, so this is new for me. I have already met some of you on calls, and I am looking forward to meeting the rest. Last month I visited our office in Mexico City, and I learned a lot. So, my first question for you is simple: how long have you been here, and what do you do?
